messages:
maria: Rolling v4.3 to canary (10%) now — includes paging header change (X-RW-PAGE:cursor). @ryan oncall, watch for streaming disconnects.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: sdk-streaming-errors spike detected for canary deploy 4012345678. Incident created: INC-2026-041. Pinged oncall.

ryan: Acknowledged. Looking at logs... seeing a lot of `invalid_cursor` and 400s from streaming clients within minutes of canary traffic.

simon: Metrics: stream_disconnect_rate jumped from 0.2% -> 6.7% for canary hosts. Errors correlated with requests that include the new paging header.

maria: Repro locally with old client. The header rename changed server parsing order. Old clients send `X-RW-PG` and v4.3 expects `X-RW-PAGE`. Patch incoming.

ryan: Sample error from prod logs:
```
ERROR decode_cursor: failed to base64-decode cursor: illegal base64 data at input byte 22
client_id=acme-inc-123 route=/v1/stream
```

maria: Ok. Strategy: kill the feature flag for paging_v2 and start rollback of v4.3 canary. @infra-bot please flip `ff/paging_v2` -> false and start rollback if that doesn't stabilise in 2m.

infra-bot: `ff/paging_v2` set to `false` by maria at 2026-03-17T22:13:12Z :white_check_mark:

ryan: Toggling flag now...

ryan: Flag flipped. Monitoring.

simon: After flip, disconnect rate down to 0.6% on canary hosts. Still a few errors but trending down. :thumbsup:

maria: Good. Start rollback of canary to v4.2.

infra-bot: Rollback job started: deployment/v4.3 -> v4.2. Jobs: 8/8 rolled back on canary pool.

ops_lead: Customer impact? Any 5xx spikes to external customers?

product_rc: Any paying customers hit streaming errors?

ryan: Looking at request ids flagged. Mostly SDK v3.x streaming clients using old header — ~430 failed requests across canary slice over 12 minutes. Impacted customers: acme-inc (EU), beta-corp (edge). Reached out to account leads.

maria: Notify support + account teams. Postmortem to include backward compatibility checklist and canary size reduce. We'll also add server-side accept of old header alias for a short-term patch.

product_rc: We'll draft an outbound note to affected customers. Turnaround ASAP.

infra-bot: Rollback completed successfully at 2026-03-17T22:25:03Z :white_check_mark:

ryan: Confirmed stability for last 10 minutes. No further spike.

maria: Incident severity SEV2. Creating follow-up tickets: 
- revert PR for v4.3
- server-accept-legacy-header
- reduce-canary-percent-default

maria: Handoff to simon for overnight watch. Ryan done for today. Simon you're oncall for follow-up.

simon: Acknowledged. Will monitor dashboards and work on the compatibility patch in the morning.

maria: Thanks team. Closing incident thread; will post postmortem link when ready. :pray:
